column6: Jackiw-Rebbi exercise worked: m(x) sign change gives normalizable zero mode psi ~ exp(-int m/v). Old text note: Q2 (index 2) is a true-false item whose stem is a "what" question, so answer "true" is meaningless; Q1 option 1 says "only forward scattering is allowed" (overstated).

Bullet 2: "Only direct backscattering is suppressed" was wrong; the surface matrix element ~cos^2(theta/2) also reduces large-angle scattering. Changed to "Only direct backscattering is fully forbidden."

Worked H_c2 = Phi0/(2 pi xi^2): xi=2 nm gives 82 T, xi=100 nm gives 0.033 T; both match. Surface-energy signs correct (xi>>lambda positive, lambda>>xi negative). Old text note: Core Idea uses banned word "essential".

Bullet 1: "carries a steady current without dissipation" was an absolute; thermally activated flux creep gives small dissipation at finite T. Also, pinning disorders the vortex lattice. Changed to "Pinned vortices let a steady current flow with almost no dissipation. Clear resistance appears..."
Allowed h^2+k^2+l^2 verified: BCC 110,200,211,220 = 2,4,6,8; FCC 111,200,220,311 = 3,4,8,11. KCl: F_odd = 4(f_K - f_Cl), K+ and Cl- isoelectronic, so all-odd peaks nearly vanish. Correct.
Bullet 3: the correction said every missing peak is F=0. That drops a qualifier, since a peak can also be missing from range limits or low intensity. Added "In a systematic absence,".
